relationships.subject: 5-HT1A receptor
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that activating VLO 5-HT<sub>1A</sub> receptor produced dose-dependent antidepressant effects, which were blocked by a selective antagonist

relationships.subject: VLO GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Chemogenetic activation of VLO GABAergic neurons abolished the antidepressant effects of 5-HT<sub>1A</sub> receptor stimulation.

relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI-induced depressive-like behaviors correlated with reduced 5-HT<sub>1A</sub> receptor expression in the VLO

key_findings: VLO 5-HT1A receptor activation alleviates SNI-induced depressive-like behaviors through GABAergic disinhibition.
5-HT1A overexpression on GABAergic neurons rescues, and knockdown induces, depressive-like behavior.
